elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide transition assistance

elements.element: Assistance available for up to 6 months
elements.evidence: transition assistance for up to 6 months
return to Client all Client Content and other Client data

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format

elements.evidence: within 30 days after such expiration or termination, return to Client

elements.element: Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: (c) thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems
and certify such deletion to Client in writing
transition assistance for up to 6 months
within 30 days after such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content and other Client data

reasons: The inserted Section 14a expressly states all preferred atomic elements: up to 6 months' assistance at then-current rates, return of Client data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiration or termination, and deletion with written certification thereafter.
The deterministic check flagging the absent 30-day return trigger is contradicted by the operative text, which reads 'within 30 days after such expiration or termination'; the element is met.
The 'at Client's request' condition attaches only to limb (a) transition assistance and does not swallow the mandatory return, deletion or certification obligations in limbs (b) and (c).

Minimality is satisfied: the Agreement had no exit mechanics, and a single concise new section was added without altering the term, non-renewal, name-server/hosting migration or termination-notice provisions.
No undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced; 'Client Content' and the parties' defined names are used consistently.
